title: Find K-th Smallest Pair Distance
description: Find the k-th smallest distance among all pairs (nums[i], nums[j]) where i < j.
pseudocode:
1. nums.sort((a, b) => a - b)
2. low = 0, high = nums[n-1] - nums[0]
3. while low < high:
4.   mid = Math.floor((low + high) / 2)
5.   if countPairs(mid) < k: low = mid + 1
6.   else: high = mid
7. return low

steps.note: Sort array to facilitate sliding window distance counting.
Initialize binary search range: low = 0, high = 2
Count pairs with distance <= 1. Pairs are (1,1) dist 0, (1,3) dist 2. Count is 1.
Since count (1) < k (3), increase low to mid + 1 = 2.
